remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature [note of backing inscription 1]. Two pink apples on table. Note: O'Keeffe thinks apple group painted about 1921." Backing inscription 1 dates 1920? and backing inscription 3 dates 1920 and indicates no. 83 in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1921. Dated 1920 on basis of O'Keeffe–Stieglitz correspondence. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 20. For a discussion of the relationship between this subject matter in O'Keeffe paintings and Stieglitz photographs, see Sarah Greenough, "From the American Earth: Alfred Stieglitz's Photographs of Apples," *Art Journal* 41 (Spring 1981). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Apples #1

description: Two bright red apples sit atop a table or cabinet. The cabinet's corner is visible at the bottom left of the composition. Overall, the objects in the work appear slightly shadowy, as though being seen in a dark room at night.
title: Apples – No. 1
